Export is an explicit human action (debug API or the settings-panel button). ?playlog=0 disables it entirely.

phase8.extraAgentsReason: The default budget was 1 low + 1 sonnet + 1 reviewer. Four Sonnet waves were used instead of one because three of them edit files the others also touch (src/localization/i18n.ts by B and C, src/scenes/GameScene.ts by A and B), and running them concurrently would have raced those edits; splitting by file ownership and running them in sequence was the safe form. Wave D was separated because the verification suites can only be written after A-C land. No Opus reasoning pass was triggered: no suite failed twice, no balance tradeoff was ambiguous, and the single e2e failure (reset-data clicking a stale settings-panel coordinate after the export button shifted the rows) had an obvious cause and a one-line fix.
reviewFindings: playlog.exportJson() read the raw entries array while entries() returned [] when disabled, so a disabled log could still export its pre-disable contents — inconsistent with the privacy claim. Fixed: exportJson() now goes through entries().
NetClient.onclose recorded net:disconnect even for a socket that never opened, inflating the drop metric for anyone who launched with the server down. Fixed: only a socket past 'connecting' counts.
Both fixes covered by a new test; 234/234 and both verify suites re-run green afterwards.
